mc97249d201: Your kid gets a phone call from the North Pole. You get the full backstage tour — what's actually happening, how it's kept safe, and how to make the moment land perfectly.
mb7a0efe088: When your child calls, they're talking to a live AI performance of Santa — a video avatar with a warm, unhurried voice, holding a real two-way conversation in real time. Nothing is pre-recorded and no two calls are the same. Before the call, you tell us your child's name and, if you like, their age, city, wish list, and something good they did this year. Santa opens with their name and works those details in naturally — that's the moment jaws drop.
mf3441e5ee5: You control recordings. Calls are not recorded automatically. On supported calls, you can record the screen and both voices locally, then choose whether to save the video to Photos. Our call provider can retain conversation transcripts; account deletion removes them. (Full privacy policy.)
m38287c6686: Santa never asks for personal information. He's instructed not to ask where your child lives, what school they attend, or anything of the sort — you provide the personal touches, never the child.
m03802fe1ef: No gift promises. Santa is warm and encouraging about wish lists but never commits to delivering a specific present. That promise stays yours to make.
mfd6e2c312d: A parental gate stands in front of anything involving money or leaving the app — kids can't buy minutes or wander to the web.
ma847745d06: Calls have a natural end. Conversations are capped at six minutes — long enough for real magic, short enough that Santa says a warm goodbye before attention (or your minutes) run out.
m85164cc036: Fill in the wish list beforehand. One or two real items your child actually asked for. Hearing Santa already knows is the whole trick.
m014da0243f: Add a good deed. For example: "I heard you helped your little brother learn to ride his bike…" A real detail makes the conversation personal.
m1df9d91afd: Stay in the room. Partly for safety, mostly because you'll want to see their face. Prop the phone up rather than holding it — it feels more like a real video call.
ma246a10da5: Let the call end naturally. Santa wraps up on his own as time runs low. Resist the urge to stretch it — a great four-minute call beats a padded six.
m976301bd47: Ages 3 and up. Three-to-eight is the sweet spot for full belief; older kids often enjoy it as a delightful bit of theater with younger siblings.
m71018442b9: Our suggestion: "It's the way Santa makes video calls this time of year — he can't fly everywhere before Christmas Eve." Keep the answer in the world of the story. Dial Santa never breaks character on a call.
m8443476560: You buy a minute pack once — no subscription — and minutes never expire. Calls are metered by the second, and if Santa ever fails to answer or a call won't connect, those minutes come straight back. Anything ever feels off, support is a human who'll fix it fast.

me25492e528: Recording is off by default. Optional call recordings are made locally only after you choose Record and approve screen capture. mf5c6cd5256: The child's first name and the details a parent entered are passed to the AI character at the start of each call so the conversation feels personal.

m499003f5b2: On supported calls, Record captures the call screen, including the camera self-view, and both sides of the conversation. A visible recording control lets you stop recording. mf74b8c95d3: Recordings are temporary files on your device. Dial Santa does not upload them to our servers or use them for advertising. After the call, you can preview, delete, or choose Save to Photos. Saving requests permission only to add a video to your library, not to read your existing photos. If saving fails or permission is denied, the recording remains available on the call's end screen so you can try again.
mc817571199: Save a recording to Photos if you want to keep it. m3d5a402f84: A small number of companies process data on our behalf, strictly to run the product:
m3a2ce6bb45: HeyGen (LiveAvatar) and ElevenLabs — render Santa's live video and voice and process the conversation audio in real time.
m3c041fb233: LiveKit — carries the encrypted real-time audio/video stream.
mfed83b1eb9: Apple and Stripe — process purchases and receipts through their respective payment services.
m102f1748d9: Railway — hosts our servers and database (located in the United States).
m7eafcfedba: Meta — measures which Dial Santa ads led to app installs. Once, after a parent signs up and verifies their email, Meta's SDK in the app sends an install and app-open event with basic device information (such as device model, iOS version, language, time zone, and an app-specific anonymous ID). The SDK doesn't start again when the app is opened later. Meta receives this device's advertising identifier only if you allow tracking when iOS asks. Automatic event logging, automatic advanced matching, and Meta crash reports are turned off, and Meta's Limited Data Use setting is on. We do not send child profiles, names, ages, voice, call content, email addresses, account details, or purchases to Meta. Information Meta has already received is handled under Meta's own policies.
m7aacc42d86: These providers act under their own privacy and security commitments and receive only what's needed for their job. We never sell personal information.
mf53da45aed: Dial Santa is built for parents to run. Accounts, purchases, and setup are done by an adult; a parental gate protects anything involving money, privacy controls, or leaving the app. We collect from children only what a parent enters on their behalf (like a first name), plus the real-time voice processing described above — with the parent's consent, given during setup. Dial Santa does not show third-party ads. Advertising measurement is accepted by the parent at sign-up, happens once after the parent's email is verified, can be turned off under Parents, and never receives child profile or call data. We follow the principles of COPPA: minimal collection, parental consent, no behavioral advertising to children, and parental control over deletion.
mbaf9fd3aa7: Delete your account: open Parents → Account → Delete account, verify your email and confirm. We remove your account email, minute balance and call records from our active database and clear the child profile and history on that device. Other signed-in devices are signed out and clear their local account data when they next contact our server. Call-provider cleanup runs automatically in the background and retries temporary failures. Cleanup usually takes a few minutes; temporary outages can take longer. Check Parents → Account for a completion confirmation, or contact support.
m52dd1d64b5: Sign out: open Parents → Account → Sign out. Purchased minutes remain with your email, while the child profile and local history are removed from that device.
mbf9e643098: See your data: contact support to request access.
m4ba066eb97: Withdraw consent: delete your account using the controls above, or contact support.
maf85d078dd: Advertising measurement: open Parents → Privacy & safety → Turn off ad measurement. Dial Santa then shares nothing more with Meta from that device, even if you sign in again, and you stay signed in. You can also decline Apple's tracking prompt, or turn off Settings → Privacy & Security → Tracking, to withhold the advertising identifier. Some U.S. state privacy laws may treat sharing device information for ad measurement as "sharing" personal information; the Parents control is how you opt out on your device, and you can also email us.
m8d29181fca: Account deletion removes unused minutes and does not automatically issue a refund. Contact support for help with a refund.
m4a74443bc7: All traffic is encrypted in transit (HTTPS/TLS). Sign-in codes are stored only as one-way hashes and expire in 10 minutes. We keep account and purchase records while your account exists and as required for tax and accounting; call-metering records are kept only as long as needed for billing accuracy. After account deletion, we retain keyed account digests and payment references to prevent old credentials or duplicate payment notifications from restoring an erased account. Payment processors may retain transaction records. Temporary provider-erasure jobs retain the references needed to complete downstream deletion; they are removed after completion. Call transcripts and personalized call contexts kept by our call provider are removed when you delete your account.
